verses.text: The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
lines: The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses.
He turns it wherever he desires.

verses.text: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the hearts.
lines: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes,
but Yahweh weighs the hearts.

verses.text: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
lines: To do righteousness and justice
is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.

verses.text: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
lines: A high look and a proud heart,
the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

verses.text: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
lines: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit;
and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

verses.text: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
lines: Getting treasures by a lying tongue
is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

verses.text: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
lines: The violence of the wicked will drive them away,
because they refuse to do what is right.

verses.text: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
lines: The way of the guilty is devious,
but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

verses.text: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.
lines: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop
than to share a house with a contentious woman.

verses.text: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
lines: The soul of the wicked desires evil;
his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

verses.text: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
lines: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom.
When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

verses.text: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
lines: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked,
and brings the wicked to ruin.

verses.text: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
lines: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor,
he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

verses.text: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
lines: A gift in secret pacifies anger,
and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

verses.text: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
lines: It is joy to the righteous to do justice;
but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

verses.text: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
lines: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding
shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.

verses.text: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.
lines: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man.
He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.

verses.text: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.
lines: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous,
the treacherous for the upright.

verses.text: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
lines: It is better to dwell in a desert land,
than with a contentious and fretful woman.

verses.text: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man swallows it up.
lines: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise;
but a foolish man swallows it up.

verses.text: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
lines: He who follows after righteousness and kindness
finds life, righteousness, and honor.

verses.text: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
lines: A wise man scales the city of the mighty,
and brings down the strength of its confidence.

verses.text: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
lines: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue
keeps his soul from troubles.

verses.text: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
lines: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name—
he works in the arrogance of pride.

verses.text: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
lines: The desire of the sluggard kills him,
for his hands refuse to labor.

verses.text: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
lines: There are those who covet greedily all day long;
but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

verses.text: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
lines: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination—
how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!

verses.text: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.
lines: A false witness will perish.
A man who listens speaks to eternity.

verses.text: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
lines: A wicked man hardens his face;
but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

verses.text: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
lines: There is no wisdom nor understanding
nor counsel against Yahweh.

verses.text: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
lines: The horse is prepared for the day of battle;
but victory is with Yahweh.
